name: Sandhaven Beach Chalets
accommodation: 12 self-catering chalets sleeping 2 to 5, most with two bedrooms, kitchen and lounge
beachAccess: On the promenade next to Sandhaven Beach
confirmedFeatures: Kitchen, lounge with Freeview TV, central heating, free Wi-Fi, garden or patio, travel cot and high chair, open all year
overview: Family-run chalets on the South Shields promenade, looking straight out over Sandhaven Beach and the dunes. Each chalet is self-catering, most with two bedrooms, and they are open all year with free parking on site. Seafront restaurants, parks and the funfair are all within easy reach.
surfTripFit: The beach is steps from the door, so you can check the sandbanks and be in the water in minutes, then cook your own meals afterwards.
